remarks: Here it is! Come see this fully renovated, open-concept one-bedroom condo in the heart of SONO. This end unit with great window exposure features rare gated parking included in the rent! Secure access to the buildings rooftop deck with beautiful water views great for entertainment. The property offers in-house laundry conveniently located directly across from the unit, along with extra storage in addition to the ample closet space in unit. Situated in a fantastic elevator building right off Washington Street, you can enjoy SONO's vibrant atmosphere, restaurants, SoNO Collection, shops, Maritime Aquarium, and Norwalk night life. With Metro-North right around the corner and access to Calf Pasture Beach, this condo is an amazing opportunity!

facts.laundryLoc: On the 3rd floor across from the unit.
